[data-user-message-bubble]{background:rgba(15,26,54,.8)!important;border:1px solid rgba(244,96,106,.35)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}

[data-slot="composer-host"]{background:rgba(15,26,54,.82)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-color:rgba(244,96,106,.4)!important}
